records.command: :%BD#      Get Dec/Alt Antibacklash value in arc-seconds
:%BR#      Get RA/Azm Antibacklash value in arc-seconds
:CM#       Synchonize the telescope with the current database object (as above)
:CS#       Synchonize the telescope with the current right ascension and declination coordinates
:D#        Return: "\0x7f#" if the mount is moving, otherwise "#".
:EC[s]# Echo string [s] as a debug message
:FB#       Get focuser backlash amount (in steps or microns)
:FB# (get) or :FB[n]# (set) -> values in units (microns or steps)
:FB[n]#    Set focuser backlash amount (in steps or microns)
:FC#       Get focuser temperature compensation coefficient in microns per °C)
:FC[sn.n]# Set focuser temperature compensation coefficient in microns per °C (+ moves out as temperature falls)
:FD#       Get focuser temperature compensation deadband amount (in steps or microns)
:FD[n]#    Set focuser temperature compensation deadband amount (in steps or microns)
:FG#       Get focuser current position (in microns or steps)
:FI#       Get full in position (in microns or steps)
:FI# / :FM# -> RX: i32LE (units already selected by ctrl on request)
:FM#       Get max position (in microns or steps)
:FP#       Get focuser DC Motor Power Level (in %)
:FP# (get) -> RX: u8 percent (or i32 if you choose; server I gave uses u8)
:FP[n]#    Set focuser DC Motor Power Level (in %)
:FR[sn]#   Goto focuser target position relative (in microns or steps)
:FS[n]#    Goto focuser target position (in microns or steps)
:FW# -> RX: i32LE work rate (um/s or whatever your server returns)
:FW# -> i32 µm/s (NO unit-bit conversion per your clarification)
:F[...]#   Use selected focuser (defaults to the first focuser)
:F[n]#     Set focuser move or goto rate
:Fc#       Get focuser temperature compensation enable status
:Fc# (get) -> RX: u8 0/1 (if server returns payload) OR status-only
:Fc[n]#    Enable/disable focuser temperature compensation where [n] = 0 or 1
:Fh#       Move focuser target position to home
:Fp# -> status-only boolean (matches local: CE_0 if not DC)
:GG#       Get UTC offset time, hours and minutes to add to local time to convert to UTC
:GL#       Get Local Standard Time in 24 hour format
:GS#       Get the Sidereal Time as sexagesimal value in 24 hour format
:GW#       Get tracking and basic mount state
:GX80#     Get the UT1 Time as sexagesimal value in 24 hour format
:GXE6#     Get number of steps per sidereal second
:GXE7#     Get PEC worm rotation steps (from NV)
:GXE8#     Get PEC buffer size in seconds
:GXTD#     Get tracking rate offset Dec in arc-seconds/sidereal second
:GXTR#     Get tracking rate offset RA in arc-seconds/sidereal second
:GXXn# -> per-purpose value reply, rendered as original comma-separated ASCII,
:GXY0# -> "01010101" (8 chars, no terminator transmitted on CAN; we add it locally)
:Ga#       Get standard time in 12 hour format
:Gc#       Get the Local Standard Time format
:Gg#       Get Current Site Longitude, east is negative
:Gh#       Get Horizon Limit, the minimum elevation of the mount relative to the horizon
:Gt#       Get current site Latitude, positive for North latitudes
:GtH#      Get current site Latitude, positive for North latitudes
:Gv#       Get the site eleVation in meters
:LB#       Find previous catalog object subject to the current constraints
:LC[n]#    Set current target object to catalog object number
:LIG#      Get catalog object information and goto target
:LN#       Find next catalog object subject to the current constraints
:LR#       Get catalog object information including RA and Dec, with advance to next record
:LW[s]#    Write catalog object information including current target RA,Dec to next available empty record
:Lo[n]#    Select Library catalog by catalog number n
:MA#       Goto the target Alt and Az
:MD#       Goto Destination pier side for the Target Object
:MGd[n]#   Pulse guide command where n is the guide time in milliseconds
:MN#   Goto current RA/Dec but opposite Pier side (within meridian limit overlap)
:MNe#  Goto current RA/Dec but East of the Pier (within meridian limit overlap)
:MNw#  Goto current RA/Dec but West of the Pier (within meridian limit overlap)
:MP#       Goto the Current Position for Polar Align
:Me#       Move Telescope East at current guide rate
:Mgd[n]#   Pulse guide command where n is the guide time in milliseconds
:Mn#       Move Telescope North at current guide rate
:Mp#       Move Telescope for sPiral search at current guide rate
:Ms#       Move Telescope South at current guide rate
:Mw#       Move Telescope West at current guide rate
:RA[n.n]#  Set Axis1 Guide rate to n.n degrees per second
:RE[n.n]#  Set Axis2 Guide rate to n.n degrees per second
:RS#       Set guide rate: Slew           ?X (1/2 of current goto rate)
:Rn#       Set guide rate to n, where n = 0..9
:SEO#         Set coordinate origin for absolute encoders or mount coordinate memory
:ST[H.H]# Set Tracking Rate in Hz where 60.0 is the solar rate
:SX0[m],[n]#   Set align model coefficient [m] to value [n]
:SXEM,[n]#   Set mount type (for next restart) where n=0 for default
:SXTD,n.n#   Set tracking rate offset Dec in arc-seconds/sidereal second
:SXTR,n.n# Set tracking rate offset RA in arc-seconds/sidereal second
:T+#       Master sidereal clock faster by 0.02 Hertz (stored in EEPROM)
:T-#       Master sidereal clock slower by 0.02 Hertz (stored in EEPROM)
:T1#       Track dual axis off (disable Dec tracking on Eq mounts)
:TR#       Master sidereal clock reset (to calculated sidereal rate, stored in EEPROM)
:VH#      PEC index sense position in sidereal seconds
:VR#       Read PEC table entry rate adjustment (in steps +/-) for currently playing segment and its rate adjustment (in steps +/-)
:VR[n]#    Read PEC table entry rate adjustment (in steps +/-) for worm segment n (in seconds)
:VS#       Get PEC number of steps per sidereal second of worm rotation
:Vr[n]#    Read out RA PEC ten byte frame in hex format starting at worm segment n (in seconds)
:WR+#      Move PEC Table ahead by one sidereal second
:WR-#      Move PEC Table back by one sidereal second
:WR[n,sn]# Write PEC table entry for worm segment [n] (in sidereal seconds)
:W[n]#     Sets current site to n, where n = 0..3
:h?#       Get home status - has sense, auto home enabled, offset axis1, offset axis2 (in arcseconds.)
:hC#       Moves mount to the home position
:hC1,n#    Set home sense direction and home offset for axis1 arcseconds
:hC2,n#    Set home sense direction and home offset for axis2 arcseconds
:hF#       Reset mount at the home position.  This position is required for a cold Start.
:hP#       Moves focuser(s) to the park position
:hP#       Moves mount to the park position
:hP#       Moves rotator to the park position
:rC#       Move rotator to half-travel target position
:rG# -> RX: f32 degrees; convert to DMS string for LX200 output
:rW#       Get working slew rate in deg/s
:rZ#       Set rotator position to Zero degrees
:r[n]#     Set rotator move or goto rate
:rb# -> RX: i16 steps (read mode) OR no payload (write mode)
